summary: Re-ran the complete owner-to-customer API flow against the public preview: unique registration, current-user, workspace, Restaurant Experience preset, publish, anonymous 5/5/4/Yes/comment submission, responses, and analytics. The flow passed and analytics now reports 4.7. Protected endpoints reject unauthenticated requests and invalid public slugs return 404. Frontend registration reached mobile onboarding, but the browser run did not complete dashboard verification in the same context.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout/rate limiting after repeated failed login attempts; auth guidance calls for lockout after 5 failures.
server.py provides a short hardcoded fallback JWT secret (22-byte warning in logs) instead of failing fast when the environment variable is missing.

integration_issues.issue: Registration reached onboarding, but the browser test did not observe navigation to dashboard after workspace submission; server logs show the workspace POST and dashboard summary succeeded, so this may be a test-context/state timing issue and needs browser retest.

action_items: Add login brute-force lockout/rate limiting after five failures if required by the auth contract.
Remove the JWT_SECRET hardcoded fallback and require a sufficiently long environment secret.
Retest mobile onboarding/dashboard navigation in one persistent browser context.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET uses a weak hardcoded fallback and emits InsecureKeyLengthWarning; missing production security configuration should fail fast.
The regression test defines a hardcoded fallback public URL instead of requiring REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, which can mask environment misconfiguration.
seed_data_creation: Created one unique API owner/workspace/template/response and one unique UI registration owner/workspace during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API complete flow is passing with analytics average 4.7 and protected/public isolation verified. Continue with persistent-context mobile browser onboarding/dashboard retest and auth lockout verification.
rca of the issue: Analytics inconsistency from iteration 1 is resolved by iterating every answer and collecting all numeric 1-5 values. The browser assertion was inconclusive because the second automation invocation starts a fresh unauthenticated context; backend logs confirm the first context submitted workspace creation and received dashboard summary responses.
